summary: East Kootenay, BC brick-based lookout built 1948, NHLR-registered January 2026; a July 2025 blog found it standing and a 2026 list says likely still standing, unmaintained.

facts.design: cab on a tall brick base, with internal stairs and an outside final flight to the cab (NHLR; a 2025 blog says cinderblock)
facts.status_note: A July 2025 blog found it standing; a 2026 list says confirmed or likely standing and unmaintained

visit.trail_note: Reached on a forest service road; a 2026 list says access to most standing BC lookouts is difficult and usually needs a high-clearance 4WD. Road conditions near the top are not confirmed.

events.note: Registered January 2, 2026, nominated by Jake Lockwood (NHLR)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says a brick base; the 2025 blog says cinderblock. The story reports both and uses the register's description.
NHLR gives 1,921 m (6,301 ft); the blog gives 1,918 m. The story uses the register's figure.

notes_for_editor: Four sources, two non-official (a 2025 travel blog, an undated trip report) and one 2026 hiking list, plus the NHLR register entry. The blog's decommissioning dates (1970s-1980s) are vague, so no removal event is recorded; staffing as_of is the blog's 1980s. No BC Forest Service or heritage-register source on the lookout was found. Access level and whether the structure can be climbed are not established, so no access key is recorded; the story does not describe entering the structure. The Facebook group, AllTrails and Gaia pages were not cited because they are social or unverifiable. The 2026 list says 'confirmed or likely' rather than confirmed, so status is 'standing' with that caveat in the note.
